name: CNA
scope: Property & Casualty Operations = Specialty + Commercial + International. CNA's 10-K does not print a P&C Operations combined ratio; every P&C figure below is COMPUTED as the net-earned-premium-weighted average of the three reported segment ratios, using each year's own 10-K (as first reported). Cross-check 100 minus (sum of segment underwriting gain / sum of segment NEP) is possible only where the segment tables print underwriting gain (2021 comparative onward).
cat_note: computed: reported total P&C catastrophe losses $ / P&C NEP. $: 165, 380, 252, 179, 550, 397, 247, 236, 358, 240 (equals the sum of the three segments' reported cat $ every year). 2020 includes $195m COVID-19 and $61m civil unrest, which CNA classed as catastrophes.
pyd_note: computed: Note E pretax net prior year claim and claim adjustment expense reserve development for Specialty+Commercial+International ($m: -290, -298, -179, -73, -20, -49, -96, -23, -31, +51) / P&C NEP. Excludes premium development and excludes Corporate & Other (A&EP, legacy mass tort, and from 2021 legacy excess workers' comp), which ran +50 to +134 a year 2020-2025.
und_note: 2019-2025: NEP-weighted average of the segments' REPORTED 'combined ratio excluding catastrophes and development' (2019-2023 label) / 'underlying combined ratio' (2024-2025 label); 2019 taken from the FY2020 10-K comparative column. 2016-2018: COMPUTED as CR minus cat points minus PYD points (not reported by CNA in those years). CNA's reported underlying also strips premium development and interest accretion ('development-related items'), so the reported and computed versions differ by 0.1 to 0.4 points where both exist (computed: 2019 95.15, 2020 93.49, 2021 91.67, 2022 91.34, 2023 91.15, 2024 91.60, 2025 91.96).
exp_note: computed, NEP-weighted segment expense ratios; EXCLUDES the separately reported dividend ratio (P&C weighted 0.2 to 0.4 points a year).
nep_note: sum of the three segments' reported net earned premiums, $m
roe_note: Net income / average total stockholders' equity (CNA has no preferred stock outstanding in the window). Each year's numerator and both equity figures from that year's own 10-K (ending from the balance sheet, beginning from the comparative balance sheet column). CNA publishes no ROE figure in its 10-K (searched 'return on equity', 'core return on').
